course_description:
A business analytics project, like any ICT project, requires careful planning, analysis and management to ensure successful completion. This course introduces students to project management principles, in the context of large multi-disciplinary big data initiatives. It provides students with knowledge and skills in estimating risks, identifying stakeholders, understanding human and organisational factors, project leadership, and project controlling/management.

Managing Analytics Projects is offered as a part of the UQ’s Master of Business Analytics program. The course focuses on teaching the knowledge and skills required to manage a business analytics project. The topics cover the development of a typical system from the initial concept to the closing of the project and handover of the system as a business as usual system.

The course is organised into four different modules:

The course is built in a learning platform rich with an engaging learning experience. Each module is a blend of self-directed learning materials, professionally aligned assessments, case examples, social discussions, and interactive live sessions.ﾠAll the live sessions will be recorded and provided to students to enable flexible learning.

Course Changes in Response to Previous Student Feedback

The course assessment has been streamlined to address student feedback about the excessive volume and complexity of activities required to meet course requirements.

course_aims:
This course aims to provide you with the opportunity to acquire the knowledge and skills that are needed to be a successful project manager, a contributing team member or an engaged stakeholder for a business analytics project.

The course builds on related concepts from Business Analytics Foundations such as design thinking, business case development. These concepts are extended and additional concepts and skills introduced and applied, such as a specific approach to business analytics projects, in readiness for the capstone project. The course also provides a further opportunity to grow team skills and uses this experience to reflect on team management demands.

learning_outcomes.description: Effectively appraise, judge and defend analytic projects and champion organisational change for a range of stakeholders.
Design analytic projects aimed at high velocity industries and environments through practical approaches such as the business case, project plan, and test strategy.
Manage project group dynamics to achieve agreed ethical, financial, temporal, and organisational objectives and expectations.

learning_activities.topic: Topic 1.1: The BA project management journey This topic introduces business analytics and describes skills for planning business analytics projects. Live Session: This session will focus on staff and student introductions, outlining course objectives, reviewing assessments, and discussing business analytics projects. Self-directed learning: Students need to complete this week's self-directed material before the live session. Learning outcomes: L01

Topic 1.2: Setting the scene for a kickstart This topic continues to discuss skills for planning business analytics projects. Live Session: This session will focus on kickstarting your project. Together we will undertake an exercise using a generic project.. Self-directed learning: Students need to complete this week's self-directed material before the live session. Learning outcomes: L03

Module 1 Conclusion This topic continues to discuss skills for group work in business analytics projects. Live Session: This session will focus on finalising groups for the project and discussing business analytics projects. Self-directed learning: Students need to complete this week's self-directed material before the live session. Learning outcomes: L01

Topic 2.1: Business understanding This topic continues squad planning activities for business analytics projects. Live Session: This session will focus on developing the business case by understanding a business and a value proposition analysis. Self-directed learning: Students need to complete this week's self-directed material before the live session. Learning outcomes: L02, L03

Topic 2.2: Data understanding This topic continues squad planning activities for business analytics projects. Live Session: This session will continue focus on business case development and important factors in understanding business data. Self-directed learning: Students need to complete this week's self-directed material before the live session. Learning outcomes: L02, L03

Topic 2.3: Ethics and project management practices This topic explores ethical issues in business analytics projects. Live Session: This session will focus on ethical issues that emerge in business analytics projects. Self-directed learning: Students need to complete this week's self-directed material before the live session. Learning outcomes: L01, L03

Module 2 Conclusion Live Session: This session will focus on business case pitches from each squad. Self-directed learning: Students need to complete this week's self-directed material before the live session. Learning outcomes: L01, L02, L03

Topic 3.1 Daily Project Life and Challenges This session provides time for each squad to present their business case pitches and cover daily project life and challenges (time permitting). Live Session: This session will focus on business case pitches from each squad. Self-directed learning: Students need to complete this week's self-directed material before the live session. Learning outcomes: L01, L02, L03

Topic 3.2: Organisational Change This session provides time for each squad to present their business case pitches. This session discusses the dimensions of organisational change. Live Session: This session will focus on project management, organisational change, and an assessment Q&A session. Self-directed learning: Students need to complete this week's self-directed material before the live session. Learning outcomes: L01, L02, L03
Module 3 Conclusion King’s Birthday Public Holiday - Monday 5th October 2026 - Check Blackboard for announcements about affected classes. Learning outcomes: L02

Topic 4.1: Final Delivery and implementation This session discusses project finalisation. Live Session: This session will focus on final delivery planning requirements including final testing and implementation needs, and an assessment Q&A session. Self-directed learning: Students need to complete this week's self-directed material before the live session. Learning outcomes: L01, L02

Topic 4.2: The rocky last mile This session will be used to prepare for the retrospective and for assessment Q&A. This session discusses retrospectives. Live Session: This session will focus on concluding sprint activities. Self-directed learning: Students need to complete this week's self-directed material before the live session. Learning outcomes: L02, L03

Topic 4.3 Course Summary Run a retrospective for the course and discuss and reflect on its outcomes. Q&A Assessment 3. This session continues the topic of project finalisation. Live Session: This session will workshop a retrospective for the course. Self-directed learning: Students need to complete this week's self-directed material before the live session. Learning outcomes: L01, L02, L03
